summary.text: REALNOR MANAGEMENT AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2005-08-22. REALNOR MANAGEMENT AS provides property management and accounting services. Its registered purpose is to deliver management services for property and investment companies and other companies, along with related activities, and to keep accounts for others. It was previously named COLLIERS PROPERTY MANAGEMENT AS until 2022-10-27. Its main industry code is 68.320: other real estate activities on a fee or contract basis. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 6 600 016 NOK and the annual result was -1 007 788 NOK; operating income was down from 9 439 906 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from -518 943 NOK in 2024 to -1 007 788 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 697 258 NOK in 2024 to -310 530 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Jens Marius Østby Andresen (daglig leder) and Thor Bjørdal (styrets leder), with 3 other board members. Recent changes in the register: business address set to Fridtjof Nansens plass 7 on 2026-08-07.
